    woman_patches = image_patch.find("woman")
    if not woman_patches:
        return "No woman found in the image."
    
    # Sort the patches based on their rightmost edge (for right) and leftmost edge (for left)
    woman_patches.sort(key=lambda woman: woman.right)
    rightmost_woman = woman_patches[-1]
    leftmost_woman = woman_patches[0]
    
    # Use the llm_query function to answer the question
    answer = rightmost_woman.llm_query("Am I the farthest to the right?", long_answer=False)
    if answer.lower() == "yes":
        return "The woman farthest to the right is the one on my right."
    else:
        return "The woman farthest to the right is the one on my left."

        return my_left_patches[0]
